verdict.rationale: Braintrust's own docs say you can run evals on every pull request in CI/CD (docs-2, docs-27, docs-62). A headless `bt` CLI handles auth, evals, log queries and data sync from the terminal (docs-33, docs-35, probe-5). The GitHub README shows a non-interactive `BRAINTRUST_API_KEY=... npx braintrust eval` invocation (gh-3), and a programmatic API exists (docs-11). Missing for 10: no concrete CI pipeline configuration example (e.g., a GitHub Action) and no independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
